title: Add an Ada Lovelace tribute
body:
A tribute to the first programmer.

Made by: Claude Code (Claude Opus)

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@ +

Ada Lovelace (1815-1852)

+

She wrote the first published algorithm for Babbage's Analytical Engine.

+
"That brain of mine is something more than merely mortal." - Ada Lovelace
